audit.title: EthosGPT v1.0.0 revision 5 responsible open-science audit
audit.auditor: Codex technical audit under human-author governance
audit.scope: Anonymous NeurIPS 2026 four-page candidate, appendix, versioned evidence, code, visuals, and reproducibility packages

objects.scope: four-page body plus references, appendices, and official checklist
3,840 validated records and derived result tables
offline analysis, verification, figure, table, and release workflow

artifact_bindings.version: Wave 1 versioned outputs and derived results

standards.name: FAIR Principles
standards.use: findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable artifact review

standards.name: NeurIPS Paper Checklist
standards.use: limitations, reproducibility, ethics, and asset disclosure

citations.evidence: Every main-text and appendix citation resolves; 23 cited references include URLs.
WorldValuesBench and PNAS Nexus results are protocol-separated from the new experiment.

outputs.evidence: Exact four-page body, 33 pages total, embedded fonts, no unresolved citations or overfull boxes.

outputs.object: eight figures and two Draw.io masters
outputs.evidence: Source mapped, vector, editable where promised, live text at least 7 pt, and inspected at final size.
Verification, 16 unit tests, three negative tests, compilation, paper audit, and visual audit pass.
India is selected from human coordinates only; appendix cases are deterministic medoids within threshold-defined CRG classes.

claims.claim: GPT-5.6 lowers global TVD error in Wave 1.
claims.evidence: Country-bootstrap interval and Holm-adjusted sign-flip test agree across source results, tests, and manuscript.

claims.claim: Uniform subset averaging removes only the run-varying term in the finite-five pool.
claims.evidence: Exact derivation, estimates, and unit tests agree.
claims.boundary: Outputs are not agents and no interaction is observed.

claims.claim: The declared economic-weight grid favors GPT-5.6 in 88.76% of intervals.
claims.boundary: One descriptive sensitivity analysis; no estimated welfare weights.

claims.claim: The four displayed countries represent national populations or cultural regions.
claims.evidence: Country aggregates and deterministic visual case selection cannot support population or cultural representativeness.
claims.action: The manuscript explicitly makes this a non-claim.

claims.claim: The study establishes locally valid Global South representation.
claims.evidence: English-only prompts, an unweighted derivative, and no community co-design cannot support this claim.
claims.action: The manuscript explicitly makes this a non-claim.

findings.finding: The GPT-5.6 serving identifier is undated.
findings.action: Preserve output and prompt hashes and avoid claims of permanent model identity.

findings.finding: The public survey derivative omits official population weights and full survey-design metadata.
No multilingual or community-led validation is available.
findings.action: Require locally governed validation in future deployment-facing work.

findings.finding: Country radars are descriptive visual cases.
findings.action: Retain the full 64-country sample for estimates and uncertainty and disclose the deterministic selection rules.

execution_runs.outputs: verification, tests, PDF, paper audit, visual audit, negative tests
statistics, spatial diagnostics, figures, tables, audited PDF

fair.findable: Versioned filenames, manifests, persistent release identities, and checksums are supplied.
fair.accessible: Manuscript and reproducibility packages are bundled; provider-side model regeneration is not promised.
fair.interoperable: CSV, JSON, YAML, SVG, PDF, TeX, Python, and Draw.io formats are used.
fair.reusable: Code, immutable outputs, licenses, prompts, tests, and exact commands are included.

human_actions: Approve the narrowed interpretation and contribution claims.
Inspect the final PDF and choose whether and where to submit.
For follow-up deployment claims, add multilingual, within-country, and community-governed validation.
